title: Slates
html:
Slates are readable items in Baldur's Gate 3 including tablets and other carved material. Reading them might start or update Quests. Most of them provide world or character lore.

Other organizational groupings of books can be found in:

  • Category:Slates
  • Githyanki Slates - provides a descriptive list of Tir'su Slates

In addition, other forms of written material can be found on these pages:

  • Books - includes a list of long form written material such as journals, ledgers, and published books
    • Category:Books
    • Books by Subject
    • Books by Author
  • Notes - includes a list of letters, notes, maps, and other short written material
    • Category:Notes
    • Notes by Author
